name: Mell
source:
Mell came to Ethger from the Northern country where she lived her whole life.
Certain circumstances prompted her to leave her homeland and start a new life in a city that barely had any mages. As she was leaving, she knew that life was not easy for magic users in Ethger, and now she has to find out which rumors about the city are true and whether things in there are as bad as people say...
